title: 2026 Year in Review:
title_short: 2026 Year in Review · Dec 13 donor event
format: 16:9 only · 1920×1080 · 23.976 fps (plays on a TV at the 13 Dec donor event)
headline: A thank-you film for the room: last December YCDIF was eight months old, and this is what its donors built in 2026. It starts in this room.
story: It plays once, on a TV with sound, at YCDIF's donor event at Rob's house on 13 Dec (20 to 30 donors and prospects). It opens where last year's event was, at The Ends, with Rob's own words from that night. Seven short chapters show the year: Heartland Ranch, Dr. Phil, FreedomFest, You Can Do It, America!, spotlight partners, social growth and grants. It closes on Rob, a thank-you to the room and his <q>You can do it!</q>.

V1 is the base. Keep its structure, timing, music and bites. The open work is the placeholders: partner clips that YCDIF is collecting, the social numbers from MyBizNiche, and the facts Clint confirms. Loops: L1 “Eight months old, and then what?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:31 on “In 2026, here's what you built.” L2 “What did we build?” runs through the chapters and closes at 1:50 on “And it starts in this room.”
do: Start from V1 and keep its order, timing and music. Fill the placeholders only.
Hook text <q>Last December, we were eight months old.</q> on frame 1, over The Ends menu.
Use only Rob's culture and gratitude lines from the Dec 2025 speech, as in V1.
Drop each partner clip into its slot when YCDIF sends it. Keep the slot length.
Grade every clip and fade out slowly on the end card.
dont: No logo before the end card. No black or fade at 0:00.
Nothing political from Rob's speech. No other lines from it.
Never call Rob a founder or a grant recipient. He is the spokesperson.
Do not change V1's number cards until Clint confirms them.
No freeze frames and no held stills of a speaker.
